name: Beryl
source:
The first prince of the Yellow Country. Although he is a prince, he commands the Knights of the Yellow Country. He helps the protagonist when she is attacked by a gang of thugs. He is kind and polite, but also a little insensitive to other people's feelings. 

"Yes. I am Beryl of the Royal Knights. Pleased to make your acquaintance."

[Adapted from [url=https://game.mba-international.jp/monomagiacantabile/]official website[/url]]
